appearance_facts.fact: The chart title reads 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'. This text explicitly describes an increasing trend.
The Y-axis is labeled 'Production'. The scale runs from 0 to 3,000 with major grid lines every 200 units.
The X-axis is labeled 'Year'. The tick marks correspond to the years 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.
A single blue line plots the production values. It starts at a high point in 2018, drops in 2019, peaks in 2020, and then remains relatively flat with a slight downward slope from 2021 to 2023.
The highest point on the line graph occurs at the year 2020, reaching a value slightly above 2,800.
The lowest point on the line graph occurs at the year 2019, reaching a value just below 2,400.
